title: Almgren wins on marathon debut, Chepkirui regains title in New York

story.W: A cautious start (halfway in 1:13:52) left the race to be decided in Central Park. Sheila Chepkirui covered Hellen Obiri's kick with 400 m to go and sprinted clear; Jessica McClain passed Obiri for second by one second.
story.M: A large pack ran together until a surge at mile 23 cut it to four. Andreas Almgren, on his marathon debut, pulled away from Yemaneberhan Crippa in Central Park to win by 13 seconds.

performances.name: Andreas ALMGREN
performances.note: Won on his marathon debut. Sat in the pack throughout, looked untroubled, led narrowly at 40 km and eased away from Crippa in Central Park.

performances.name: Yemaneberhan CRIPPA
performances.note: Second, 13 seconds back, after being one of the last two in contention. He won Paris earlier in the year.

performances.name: Kamohelo MOFOLO
performances.note: Fast finish for third in a personal best, passing Benson Kipruto on the line.

performances.name: Benson KIPRUTO
performances.note: The defending champion made the decisive surge at mile 23 (a 4:38 mile) but was dropped late and lost third on the line.

performances.name: Zouhair TALBI
performances.note: Attacked repeatedly from halfway (1:04:01) but each move was covered; first of the final four to be dropped, finished sixth.

performances.name: Sheila CHEPKIRUI
performances.note: Regained the title she won in 2024. Shadowed by Obiri all the way, she covered Obiri's kick with 400 m left and sprinted away.

performances.name: Jessica MCCLAIN
performances.note: Led at halfway, was dropped by the leaders, then closed in Central Park to take second by one second: the first US woman in the top three since 2018.

performances.name: Hellen OBIRI
performances.note: The defending champion kicked with 400 m to go but could not hold it and was passed for second on the line. The report notes an injury scare in July.

performances.name: Edna KIPLAGAT
performances.note: Fourth at the age of 46, in the lead group of eight late into the race.
